newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Spanish bank seen boosting stake in IEB.
newsitem.headline: Spanish bank seen boosting stake in IEB.

text.p: Spain's Banco de Santander is planning to boost its stake in Hungary's Inter-Europa Bank (IEB) to about 10 percent, IEB officials said on Wednesday.
"According to our information it (Banco Santander) strives to acquire 10 percent," Laszlo Body, chairman of IEB's board, told Reuters on Wednesday.
Santander bought about five percent stake in IEB during the summer and has an option to increase this holding to 9.9 percent before end of the year.
Italian Gruppo Bancario San Paolo is IEB's biggest single shareholder with 32.5 percent of the bank's capital. Its stake will remain unchanged, IEB officials said.

IEB officials met journalists at the opening a new bank branch. In a statement, IEB said its pre-tax profit amounted to 1.32 billion forints at the end of August while its balance sheet total stood at around 75 billion forints.
The bank said a pretax profit for the year of 2.25 billion forints is achievable.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange IEB shares closed at 36,950 forints, up 1,900.
